notes: Expt 1 (single token, single exemplar). Habituation: each 14-s trial shows one object with 7 repetitions of its label; the two pairs alternate (each twice per block of 4), so each word gets half the trials. Criterion: looking over a later block of 4 <= 50% of the first block, min 8, max 24 trials. Per-infant counts are not in Peekbank, so this is the experiment's expected count: 19/34 infants met criterion (mean 17.5 trials), 15 saw 24; mean 20.4 trials = 10.2 per word (range 4-12).

Expt 2 (7 tokens per trial from different speakers). Habituation: each 14-s trial shows one object with 7 repetitions of its label; the two pairs alternate (each twice per block of 4), so each word gets half the trials. Criterion: looking over a later block of 4 <= 50% of the first block, min 8, max 24 trials. Per-infant counts are not in Peekbank, so this is the experiment's expected count: 10/27 met criterion (mean 18 trials), 17 saw 24; mean 21.8 trials = 10.9 per word (range 4-12).

Expt 3 (7 color exemplars per trial, one token). Habituation: each 14-s trial shows one object with 7 repetitions of its label; the two pairs alternate (each twice per block of 4), so each word gets half the trials. Criterion: looking over a later block of 4 <= 50% of the first block, min 8, max 24 trials. Per-infant counts are not in Peekbank, so this is the experiment's expected count: 11/24 met criterion (mean 18.9 trials), 13 saw 24; mean 21.7 trials = 10.8 per word (range 4-12).
